title: A scalable recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled peptides — code and data
description: Analysis code and sequence-free source data for a 96-well recombinant pipeline for disulphide-stapled cyclic peptides: automated IVA primer design, qPCR cloning QC, periplasmic secretion and DOC lysis, IMAC, SEC yield analysis with hierarchical clustering, and Ellman's free-thiol staple QC. Includes the designed expression construct (His6-SUMO-linker-ccdB in pET-24b(+)). Notebooks 1, 2 and 4 run end-to-end on a bundled synthetic example; notebook 3 (SEC) reproduces Figure 4 using the third-party SAPP_DMX engine (github.com/bwicky/SAPP_DMX) plus user-supplied raw HPLC traces (see code/REPRODUCE_figure4_SEC.md). Designed peptide sequences are withheld (intellectual property) and binding-target names are anonymised (Target 1-9). LICENSING: code (code/) is MIT; data and construct (data/, construct/) are CC BY 4.0.
